verdict.rationale: Meltano is a CLI-first ELT/data-pipeline tool built on extractors, loaders and utility plugins, with no AI or agent component. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is an agent (MCP client) role, which falls outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows Meltano consumes MCP servers or has any tool-using LLM layer that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
